task:
Perform an etcd backup and then restore it to verify cluster recovery.

Context: You are working on the control plane node of a kubeadm cluster.

Step 1 - Take a snapshot backup:
  ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /opt/etcd-backup.db \
    --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 \
    --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt \
    --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt \
    --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key

Step 2 - Create a test resource to confirm it disappears after restore:
  kubectl create namespace backup-test
  kubectl run test-pod --image=nginx:1.21 -n backup-test

Step 3 - Restore the snapshot to a new data directory:
  ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot restore /opt/etcd-backup.db \
    --data-dir=/var/lib/etcd-restored

Step 4 - Update the etcd static pod manifest to use the restored data dir:
  Edit /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml
  Change the hostPath volume from /var/lib/etcd to /var/lib/etcd-restored

Step 5 - Wait for etcd to restart (~30s), then verify cluster is working:
  kubectl get nodes
  kubectl get pods -n backup-test   # namespace should NOT exist (pre-backup state)

Note: After editing etcd.yaml the kubelet will automatically restart the etcd pod.
Use: watch crictl ps  to monitor the restart.
hints: Certificate paths on kubeadm: /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt, server.crt, server.key
After restore, edit /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml hostPath volume path
Check: kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep etcd  to confirm etcd is Running
detailed_hints: Verify backup: ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot status /opt/etcd-backup.db --write-out=table
In etcd.yaml find 'volumes:' section, change 'path: /var/lib/etcd' to 'path: /var/lib/etcd-restored'
Also update the volumeMounts hostPath in the same file
Wait for etcd pod to restart: watch kubectl get pods -n kube-system

validators.description: etcd pod is running in kube-system
validators.command: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l component=etcd -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.phase}'

validators.description: kube-apiserver is running (cluster functional after restore)
validators.command: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l component=kube-apiserver -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.phase}'
